project_name: Harmeet Kour - Awwwards-Grade Personal Portfolio & Professional History
target_audience: Tech Recruiters, Engineering Managers, Tech Executives, Product Leaders
design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 7 / SWISS HYBRID - Performance Kinetic Dark

typography.font_family_heading: Syne, Clash Display, or Space Grotesk (Display Sans with attitude)
typography.font_family_body: Plus Jakarta Sans or Inter (Clean, highly legible body)
typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono or Fira Code (For metrics, tech stack tags, timestamps)

colors.palette_name: Cybernetic Obsidian & Electric Electric Cyan / Violet Flare

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous Spacing Scale: p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, py-24, py-32

grid_system.mode: MODE A: TETRIS / BENTO ASYMMETRIC GRID
grid_system.hero_layout: Full width kinetic text stack with offset interactive 3D hero card + floating quick metrics
grid_system.experience_timeline: Numbered manifesto chapter layout with sticky timeline bar and interactive expanded roles
grid_system.skills_bento: Asymmetric multi-span layout: Core Stack (col-span-8), DevOps & Tools (col-span-4), Leadership & Soft Skills (col-span-4), Code Architecture (col-span-8)
grid_system.projects_grid: Grid with staggered card heights, custom live preview drawer/modal, GitHub/Live links, metric pills

surface_and_textures.navigation_header: Crystal Glassmorphism (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/10 z-50)
surface_and_textures.cards: Subtle glassmorphism + 1px tracing line border glow on hover + backdrop-blur-md
surface_and_textures.marquee: Editorial kinetic tape with ultra-slow smooth scroll, high-contrast monospace typography and tech tags
surface_and_textures.textures: Subtle grain noise overlay on dark background to break digital flatness

motion_and_interactions.scroll_engine: Lenis smooth momentum scrolling (installed or implemented smoothly)
motion_and_interactions.hero_animation: Masked line-by-line reveal on load using Framer Motion (staggerChildren: 0.12, duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1])
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveals: Scroll-triggered section entry with subtle parallax offset (-20px to +20px)

micro_interactions.buttons: Hover magnet tilt effect or glow expansion on focus/hover
micro_interactions.cards: Scale 1.01 with border-cyan-400/50 glow transition on hover
micro_interactions.links: Animated underline sweep from left to right

motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion, aria-hidden on purely decorative canvas/particles

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the design looks like an Awwwards Site of the Day winner with dark kinetic styling.
Do NOT use generic Inter font for main titles; use Syne, Space Grotesk, or Clash Display via Google Fonts in index.html.
Implement line-by-line reveal animation on hero load using framer-motion variants.
Use framer-motion for smooth scroll reveals on all manifesto section titles.
Ensure every interactive link and button has a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
Use sonner for toast notifications when email is copied or contact form is submitted.
Add a floating sticky nav bar with glassmorphism backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60).
Include a live downloadable resume button and copy email button in header and contact section.
Ensure full responsiveness across mobile, tablet, and wide desktop viewports.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop: Avoid generic centered layouts and standard blue gradients. Maintain deep obsidian backgrounds (#0A0A0E) with razor-sharp 1px subtle borders.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Never use transition: all. Use specific transition classes (e.g. transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-300).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.alignments: Do not center align the main app container. Maintain left-aligned, structured editorial text flow.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing: All key buttons, inputs, links, and cards MUST include data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use sonner for toast notifications (located in components/ui/sonner.tsx).
